subject: Close cadence: slip metering, accountability runbook & credit threshold escalation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close cadence: slip metering, accountability runbook & credit threshold escalation

Liam — quick update after our internal pacing review this morning. We spotted a procurement gating risk on the acceptance path that is likely to push the close window beyond the current MAP buffer. Key points: 

- Procurement approval for the legal PO is still pending (Sara Park is the contact).
- Current acceptance window targeted for 2025-08-04 now has ~7 business days of exposed risk if procurement slips.
- We want to avoid a hard reset to the program cadence, so proposing a short "slip metering" approach: meter any schedule drift in 3-day increments and keep incremental commitments to avoid a full rebaseline.

Attached: HelioHealth_MAP_v3.xlsx (updated milestones) — I pushed an initial risk column and the current acceptance gating items. Can you confirm whether your procurement team expects any additional documents this week? If procurement needs more time, we need a decision on whether to trigger a credit threshold (we've got flexibility up to a certain level but need leadership signoff if >7 business days).

Ask: Please confirm by EOD today: (1) procurement ETA, (2) whether Helio can accept a short 5-7 day soft extension, or (3) whether they require a formal rebaseline. We'll escalate to sales leadership if we cross the 7-day threshold.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: HelioHealth_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Park <sara.park@procureops.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close cadence: slip metering, accountability runbook & credit threshold escalation

Marissa — thanks for the heads up and for the clear note. Quick answer: procurement has one outstanding question on our SOC2 evidence attestation (they want the SOC2 control matrix exported and a short note from your security team clarifying retention for logs). Sara is on copy and she's coordinating internally. We expect a formal PO to be routed next week but cannot guarantee an earlier ETA.

On the recommended options: HelioHealth would prefer to avoid multiple date rebaselines. A soft 7-day extension is acceptable to the exec sponsor, but any extension beyond that requires an internal Procurement review and could push acceptance by 2-3 weeks. We are comfortable with a metered approach but will need the SOC2 matrix and a one-page confirmation on log retention ASAP (Sara, can you advise?).

I'll loop procurement to keep the timeline transparent.

- Liam
Liam O'Neal
VP, Platform Operations — HelioHealth
liam.oneal@heliohealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Close cadence: slip metering, accountability runbook & credit threshold escalation

Adding a structured risk log (see attached) and a short playbook we can run if procurement slips. TL;DR: 

- Likely exposure: 5–12 business days depending on SOC2 artifact turnaround.
- Recommended immediate actions: 
  1) Provide SOC2 control matrix + retention confirmation to Sara within 24 hours (Security can draft).
  2) Trigger "metering" cadence: weekly slip checkpoints with Helio PM and procurement owner.
  3) If slip >7 business days, escalate to Sales Leadership and propose capped credit concession (recommendation below).

Proposed credit threshold: up to $15k credit (to be approved by Sales Leadership) for soft-extension buckets (<=10 business days). Anything beyond 10 business days requires a formal rebaseline and Exec sign-off.

Attached: helio_risk_log.csv (CSV, 18KB) — includes root cause, owner, mitigation ETA.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: HelioHealth procurement gating — request for conditional credit approval

Neha — brief escalation. HelioHealth procurement may introduce a SOC2 evidence hold that could create a 7–12 business day slip to our acceptance window. Camila's attached risk log calls for a capped credit concession (recommend $15k) if we meter slips <=10 business days. Helio is signaling they prefer a metered extension to frequent rebaselines; they can accept up to 7 business days without internal procurement review.

Request: Can you approve a conditional credit authorization (up to $15k) and instruct Security to produce the SOC2 control matrix + retention note for Sara within 24 hours? If approved, we'll use the metering playbook and avoid a formal rebaseline for now.

Attachment: escalation_brief.pdf (PDF, 45KB) — one-page summary for leadership.

Thanks — we need a quick yes/no to keep momentum.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: HelioHealth procurement gating — request for conditional credit approval

Marissa / team — approve conditional credit up to $15,000 for a single metered slip event up to 10 business days. Please note: credit must be applied as one-time concession against Month 1 usage and documented in the MAP addendum. If cumulative slip exceeds 10 business days, we will require a formal rebaseline and a revised commercial sign-off.

Action items for Sales Ops: 
- Camila: update MAP to v4, add the metered-slip clause and credit addendum; share updated MAP with Helio and attach to HubSpot deal record.
- Marissa: confirm with Helio that SOC2 control matrix will be delivered within 24 hours and lock the weekly metering cadence.
- Rishi: prepare final credit ledger entry template for Finance.

I'll monitor through the week and will step in if we see further drift. Thanks for the concise briefing.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
